name: open-pages
description: Typora-like Markdown editor with Hexo preview and GitHub Pages publish.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @open-pages/shared build && pnpm --filter @open-pages/github build && pnpm --filter @open-pages/github-auth build && pnpm --filter @open-pages/hexo-runner build && pnpm --filter @open-pages/publish build && pnpm --filter @open-pages/api build && pnpm --filter @open-pages/web build
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @open-pages/desktop prepare-runtime && pnpm --filter @open-pages/desktop build
